questions.question: When passengers ride a bus, what should be in the aisle?

options.text: Items can be left in the aisle.
Items can be left in the aisle if everyone is seated.
Nothing should block the aisle.
Items can be left in the aisle if there is an orange cone beside them.

questions.explanation: Keep the aisle clear of all items while the bus is moving. Aisles and stairwells must always be free of anything blocking the way.

questions.question: Buses must never carry which of these?

options.text: Tear gas
Any amount of solid Class 6 poisons
Bottled oxygen
Emergency hospital supplies

questions.explanation: Buses cannot carry radioactive materials, poison gas, liquid Class 6 poisons, tear gas, or irritating materials.

questions.question: What should a driver always do?

options.text: Stay in their lane
Have a plan for emergencies
Stay in the left lane
Drive above the speed limit

questions.explanation: Watch the road ahead to spot dangers early. Plan how you will handle problems if they become dangerous.

questions.question: Which is NOT a distracted person that drivers should worry about?

options.text: A driver talking to another person in the vehicle
Children on the side of the road
Construction workers on the side of the road
A person sitting on a bench waiting for a bus

questions.correctAnswerText: A person sitting on a bench waiting for a bus
questions.explanation: Drivers talking to passengers may not pay full attention to the road. Children may run into the road without looking. Be careful near road workers to keep them safe. A person sitting on a bench waiting for a bus is not a distraction concern.

questions.question: When should you tell passengers about comfort rules like smoking?

options.text: Only if someone breaks a rule
Only if a passenger asks about something
At the start of the trip
Talk to each passenger about them separately

questions.correctAnswerText: At the start of the trip
questions.explanation: Many buses have rules about smoking, drinking, and music. Tell passengers about these rules at the beginning of the trip to prevent problems later.

questions.question: If you are driving slowly and might block other vehicles, what should you do?

options.text: Stay in the left lane
Use your emergency flashers
Do not use any lights
Wave your arm out the window

questions.explanation: When driving slowly, use emergency flashers to warn other drivers. Check that local laws allow the use of emergency flashers.

questions.question: What should you do when leaving your vehicle?

options.text: Apply the parking brake
Apply the air brakes
Do not apply any brake
Disconnect the trailer

questions.explanation: Always apply the parking brake when you leave your vehicle.

questions.question: What is the best way to check your lights during a pre-trip inspection?

options.text: Park near a mirror to see the reflection
Turn on the lights, then get out of the vehicle to look at them
Look at the instrument panel for warning lights
Drive in traffic and wait for other drivers to tell you if lights are out

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on the lights, then get out of the vehicle to look at them
questions.explanation: Turn on your lights and then step out of the vehicle to check them during a pre-trip inspection.

questions.question: When inspecting the inside of a bus, what should you do?

options.text: Loosen every seat
Check every handhold
Assume all buzzers work
Remove the emergency exit handles

questions.explanation: Make sure everything inside the bus is safe and working. Check that every handhold and railing is secure and safe to use.

questions.question: When driving a 50-foot truck at 50 mph, what is the minimum following distance?

options.text: Four seconds
Five seconds
Six seconds
Eight seconds

questions.explanation: At speeds below 40 mph, maintain one second of following distance for every 10 feet of vehicle length. At higher speeds, add one more second.

questions.question: Which statement is correct?

options.text: A rim with a missing lug nut is safe if it has at least four other lug nuts.
A cracked lock ring is safe if you drive under 55 mph.
A missing clamp is dangerous and must be fixed.
Welded repairs are safe for rear axle wheels.

questions.correctAnswerText: A missing clamp is dangerous and must be fixed.
questions.explanation: Missing clamps, spacers, studs, or lugs are dangerous. Cracked or bent lock rings are not safe. Wheels or rims with welded repairs are not safe.

questions.question: If an oncoming driver has high beam headlights on, what should you do?

options.text: Look directly at the headlights.
Flash your high beams to remind them to switch to low beams.
Look toward the right side of your lane until they pass.
Pull to the side of the road until they pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of your lane until they pass.
questions.explanation: When a vehicle comes toward you with high beams on, look away from the lights and toward the right side of the road until it passes. This keeps you from being blinded.

questions.question: What is the name for a thin layer of ice on road surfaces?

options.text: White ice
Black ice
Green ice
Blue ice

questions.explanation: Black ice is a thin, clear layer of ice. You can see the road through it. A road with black ice may look wet. Be careful when temperatures are below freezing and the road looks wet.

questions.question: When checking your vehicle before driving, why should you look under it?

options.text: To see if the vehicle is on an incline
To check for fresh fluid leaks
To see if the vehicle is in a parking spot
To see if the vehicle is on a decline

questions.correctAnswerText: To check for fresh fluid leaks
questions.explanation: Before driving, look under your vehicle to check for fresh oil, coolant, grease, or fuel leaks. Leaks can mean your vehicle has unsafe problems.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while driving?

options.text: Keep driving
Drink coffee
Stop and rest
Drive faster to finish your trip

questions.explanation: If you feel drowsy, the only safe choice is to leave the road and sleep. Stimulants like coffee can be dangerous because extreme tiredness can happen when they wear off.

questions.question: What is a trailer brake hand valve used for?

options.text: Add fuel to the vehicle
Stop the vehicle from rolling backward when starting from a stop
Check the oil level
Load cargo

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop the vehicle from rolling backward when starting from a stop
questions.explanation: A trailer brake hand valve prevents the tractor-trailer from rolling backward when starting from a stop.

questions.question: If you are turning left and there are two left turn lanes, which one should you use?

options.text: The left lane
The right lane
Either lane
Large vehicles should not turn where there are two left turn lanes

questions.explanation: Large vehicles need more room to turn left. If there are two left turn lanes, use the right lane to start your turn.

questions.question: Is a curve's posted design speed safe for all vehicles?

options.text: It is safe for buses
It is safe for all vehicles, including buses
It is the minimum speed for the curve
It is not always safe for buses

questions.correctAnswerText: It is not always safe for buses
questions.explanation: Even in good weather, a bus driving at the posted curve speed can roll over or slide off the road. For safety, slow down before taking a curve in a bus.

questions.question: In an engine fire, what should you NOT do?

options.text: Turn the engine off as soon as possible
Keep the fire from spreading
Open the hood
Spray foam from under the vehicle

questions.explanation: In an engine fire, turn off the engine right away. Do not open the hood if you can help it. Spray foam through the louvers or from underneath the vehicle.

questions.question: What should a charter bus driver do about boarding passengers?

options.text: Show passengers how to use the TVs if the bus has them
Not let passengers board until the scheduled departure time
Let passengers board early to leave ahead of schedule
Tell passengers to fill the back of the bus first

questions.correctAnswerText: Not let passengers board until the scheduled departure time
questions.explanation: Do not allow passengers to board until the scheduled departure time. This helps prevent theft and vandalism.
